verdict.rationale: AutoGen provides multiple team/orchestration constructs (RoundRobinGroupChat, selector-based teams, graph-based workflows, Swarm with HandoffMessage) plus AgentTool for subagent composition and UserProxyAgent for human-in-the-loop, directly enabling multi-agent orchestration with handoffs, subagents, and crews within one workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks validating orchestration quality at scale beyond community anecdotes.
